description: Structure optimization (ionic positions and/or cell shape/volume)

IBRION.note: CG, robust default. Use 1 (RMM-DIIS) if close to minimum and >20 DOF

NSW.note: max ionic steps, increase if not converged

ISIF.rule: 2 for fixed cell (atoms only), 3 for full cell relaxation, 4 for shape only

EDIFFG.note: force convergence in eV/Å (negative = force criterion)

ENCUT.rule: 1.3 * max(ENMAX) for ISIF>=3 to avoid Pulay stress

volume_relaxation_isif_3.ENCUT: must be >= 1.3 * ENMAX to avoid Pulay stress

surface_slab.note: fix bottom layers via selective dynamics in POSCAR

difficult_convergence.note: damped MD for far-from-equilibrium systems, then switch to IBRION=1 or 2

workflow_notes: For volume relaxation (ISIF=3): may need 2-3 sequential runs until converged
Check that forces and stress are below threshold in OUTCAR
Use CONTCAR as POSCAR for continuation runs
